messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
**Top‑ranked tennis players (as of the latest ATP/WTA rankings released in late September 2026)**  

| Category | Player | Ranking | Notes |
|----------|--------|---------|-------|
| **Men’s singles (ATP)** | **Novak Djokovic** | World No. 1 | Holds the top spot for the third consecutive year, having maintained the No. 1 ranking since early 2024. |
| **Women’s singles (WTA)** | **Iga Świątek** | World No. 1 | Re‑claimed the top position after a brief dip in early 2025; has been a dominant force on clay and hard courts. |

If you’re interested in a specific week or a different ranking category (e.g., doubles, junior, wheelchair), let me know!
